prior_exposure: Previous public-reuse outcomes, source schemas and the newly recovered PNAS SI were inspected. SI establishes dual guides per targeting vector; exact author cell assignment thresholds remain unspecified.

guide_revision.reason: The original single-guide dominance rule may reject intended paired-guide cells. Aggregate paired guides by target and machinery before dominance filtering.
guide_revision.primary: sum of both guides >=5 UMIs; target sum >=80% of all guide UMIs; winning machinery must agree with the cell; require >=1 UMI from both expected targeting guides. NT guides are pooled, with at least two distinct NT guides detected; exact NT vector pairing is unavailable.
guide_revision.sensitivities: Report the primary target-summed rule without requiring both guide detections, plus permissive/strict paired rules. Never present these as original author assignments.
guide_revision.effects: Minimum 20 cells and 20 machinery-matched NT cells. Reuse previous measured pseudobulk CPM and passage-axis definitions. No donor-level inference from cell or gene counts.
guide_revision.retained_negative: Report all four published priority hits, target expression direction, unassigned cells and disagreement with the previous single-guide rule.

ocular.contrasts: old untreated-young; old OSK-old vector; old vector-old untreated; old OSK-young. Preserve distinct cohorts.
ocular.sensitivity: CPM thresholds 1,5,10 in both age-reference means; Pearson and Spearman; exclusion of fixed cycle and reprogramming panels; all single-library leave-one-out contrasts. Libraries are not assumed independent animals.
ocular.interpretation: Cohort shifts are a diagnostic, not corrected away. Shared-baseline correlations are labeled algebraically coupled and cannot serve as independent evidence.

human_model.task: SRSF1 versus BFP at 5d on/2d off, using 3 donors and all matched technical libraries.
human_model.model: StandardScaler fit only to two training donors; LogisticRegression C=1 balanced, seed171026; test the third donor; repeat all three folds without tuning.
human_model.features: Fixed identity, reprogramming, cycle and stress panels; compare cycle-excluded and depth/detected-gene-only variants.
human_model.control: Enumerate all within-donor 2-versus-2 label assignments if the admitted design is exactly 3 donors with 4 libraries each; else retain a documented permutation hold.
human_model.authority: Treatment recognition in a small within-study donor holdout; neither biological-age prediction nor independent study validation or efficacy. Replicate libraries cannot increase donor sample size.

synthetic.question: How do donor clustering and false positives change rare-state sampling interpretations?
synthetic.method: Beta-binomial latent donor prevalence; conditional detection sensitivity; Gauss-Jacobi integration with independent-donor products; seeded Monte Carlo checks. Clustering parameters are hypothetical.
synthetic.authority: Synthetic only. No simulated cell or model prediction can close an observed biological readout.

promotion_gate: No current R01-R04 promotion without matched observed human late and recovery data. Larger training requires an independently held-out compatible study and improvement over nuisance baselines.
